query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope AS "scope!"
                    FROM (
                        SELECT scope FROM org_default_scopes WHERE org_id = $1
                        UNION
                        SELECT scope FROM user_scope_grants
                        WHERE org_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
                          AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
                    ) AS all_scopes
                    ORDER BY scope
